'''2017 MPC Vikram Bali LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Vikram Bali]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
